transcript: These are five theater duos that I would love to see replacing death becomes her. And if you are on the death becomes her casting team, please feel free to use any of these ideas for free. First I have Renee Lise Goldsberry, and Phillipa. Soo. Now I went back and forth on this one, but I think Renee would be Madeline and Phillipa would be Helen. And as a bonus, we could even cast Jasmine Cephas Jones as Viola. Next Jane Krakowski Titus Burgess this one is a no brainer. Obviously Jane is Madeline, but I just love their chemistry together and I think having them do the show together would just be delicious. Next I have two certified theater icons Sheridan A. Scott as Madeline and Larbinanti as Helen. This one is a bit of a stretch in terms of duos because they've only done one show together, which was women on the verge of a nervous breakdown. But I just adore both of them as actresses and it's my list, so I'm counting it. And speaking of Cheryl, Renee Scott. Next I have Betsy Wolfe and Lindsay Mendez. They both starred alongside her in Everyday Rapture. Betsy Wolff, obviously. Currently starring as Madeline in death becomes her. Now do I think they would do a show together after the carousel drama? Probably not, but I would love to see it. And last, but certainly not least, Leah Michelle and Beanie Feldstein. I mean, need I say more?
classificationReason: Creator is proposing fantasy replacement casting duos for Death Becomes Her, not sharing a first-hand opinion on the production itself. No indication they attended or are reviewing the show.
